Specific Needs
Job Offer
Promo ticket*
Buy your Alfa Pendular or Intercidades ticket in advance and get up to 65% off.
The earlier, the cheaper! Make the most of this opportunity, buy your ticket at least 5 days in advance to ensure you can get your seat at the lowest prices.
The best prices are travelling to digital. As from 10 August 2026, Promo tickets are sold exclusively through digital channels and Ticket Vending Machines.
* Up to 25% off Alfa Pendular and Intercidades fares, with prices rounded up to the nearest 50 cents.
Buy now
Conditions
The advance refers to the day of travel, up to a limit of 60 days, valid for all destinations:
5 to 7 days in advance: Discount of up to 56%;
8 or more days in advance: Discount of up to 65%.
Buy your ticket from any of the available sales channels, 5 or more days in advance.
Limited offer: The discount only applies to the special offer seats available on each train. Once these seats are sold out, the full price will apply;
Cannot be used in conjunction with other special offers including return tickets.
Rounded prices: The ticket price is rounded up to the nearest 50 cents.
Please note:
The offer is limited and subject to availability of the seats reserved for this promotion.
Exchange and refund conditions
Promo tickets:
Can be exchanged, but not refunded;
Return tickets:
If only one of the journeys has been purchased with the
Promo Discount
, the ticket cannot be refunded;
Ticket exchanges:
the Promo Ticket purchase conditions apply.
Exchanging to another train time with no Promo Tickets:
If there are no
Promo Tickets
available for the new date or time slot desired, the exchange will be made for a
non-discounted ticket
and the
price difference
will be charged,
On sale from
Online ticket office
;
CP App
;
Ticket vending machines
;
Customer care line
.
Reference prices
Alfa Pendular (From Lisbon) - Turística Class
Faro - 9.00.
Intercidades (From Lisbon) - 2nd Class
Coimbra - 8.50;
Porto - 10.50;
Guimarães - 11.00;
Braga - 11.00;
Guarda - 11.00;
Viana do Castelo - 12.00.
See the prices from other stations
.
Note:
prices in euro including VAT.
